evidence.quote: Radboud Scholarship Programme
This scholarship is funded by the Profiling Fund of Radboud University.
It offers talented, highly motivated, non-EEA students with outstanding study results the opportunity to be awarded a scholarship for a complete English-taught Radboud University Master’s programme.

degree_levels.notes: Awarded programme level, not the applicant prerequisite degree.

value.note: A Radboud Scholarship will reduce your tuition fee to €2,771.- (amount to be confirmed).

evidence.quote: A Radboud Scholarship will reduce your tuition fee to €2,771.- (amount to be confirmed).
The scholarship also covers costs for visa, residence permit, health insurance and liability insurance for your stay in the Netherlands (Aon Student Insurance).
Nominal duration of Master's programme
The costs of living and studying in the Netherlands are not covered by the scholarship.
